text.title: Delivery team, FreshDrop app, agreed 1 September 2026
text.scope: all user stories in the app; done = live for buyers and the support team knows it
text.k1: Code merged to main, build green
text.k2: Unit tests cover new logic at 80%+
text.k4: Passes QA on staging, no open bugs
text.k5: Works on iOS and Android, last 2 versions
text.h1: CI pipeline; the author checks before merge
text.h2: coverage report in CI; reviewer checks the diff
text.h3: GitHub approvals; reviewer lists risks in the PR
text.h4: QA lead signs the ticket; 0 open bugs of any severity
text.h5: device farm run; QA lead checks the release notes
text.h6: designer runs the checklist; screen reader test on the main flow
text.h7: analyst checks the events in the dashboard within 24 hours
text.h8: support lead checks the help center article before release
text.auto: Build, unit tests, lint and the release checklist in Jira block the merge by themselves
text.fail: Back to In progress; a part can ship behind a feature flag if the rest is green
text.review: Every 2 sprints in the retro; the team lead makes the edits, the team votes
text.agreed: Mobile team lead, QA lead and product owner; based on the company engineering standard
text.decision: From 1 October for all stories; we add the accessibility check and drop the manual smoke test
